scenes.headline: 把一句模糊需求，写成能检查的具体规则
scenes.left:
支持取消报名，
取消后返还名额。
scenes.left_note:
先问关键问题，
不要替我决定规则。

rows.title: 问清行为
rows.body: 谁能取消？何时截止？重复操作怎么办？

rows.title: 写出验收
rows.body: 取消成功、重复取消、取消失败，分别看什么？

rows.title: 检查改稿
rows.body: 改了取消期限，哪些规则和场景需要同步？

scenes.headline: 先问清会改变实现的三个问题
scenes.left:
支持取消报名，
取消后返还名额。
scenes.left_note:
信息不足的地方，
先保留为待决定。

rows.title: 谁能取消？什么时候允许？
rows.body: 身份、报名状态、截止时间。

rows.title: 返还多少？还能再报名吗？
rows.body: 返还的数量和时机；重新报名条件。

rows.title: 重复或失败时，怎么处理？
rows.body: 报名状态和剩余名额是否变化。

scenes.headline: 用户确认规则，未决事项仍然单独保留
scenes.left:
截止前可取消
成功立即返还 1 个
重复不再返还
失败保持原样
scenes.left_note:
完整决定与原始回答，
见下方对话记录。

rows.title: 谁能操作
rows.body: 仅本人取消自己的有效报名。

rows.title: 何时可以重新报名
rows.body: 仍在报名期内，而且有剩余名额。

rows.title: 待决定：重复取消显示什么提示？
rows.body: 只确认了不重复返还，没有擅自补写提示。

scenes.headline: 把“返还名额”，变成有起点和结果的验收
scenes.left:
有明确初始状态
有具体操作
有可检查的结果
scenes.left_note:
这些是预期结果，
不是已经通过的测试。

rows.title: 取消成功：剩余名额 0 → 1
rows.body: 本人、有效报名、截止前：立即返还一个名额。

rows.title: 重复取消：剩余名额 1 → 1
rows.body: 同一条已取消报名，不能再返还一次。

rows.title: 取消失败：状态与名额保持不变
rows.body: 报名仍有效，显示“取消失败，请重试”。

scenes.headline: 改取消期限时，别把重新报名期限一起改了
scenes.left:
取消截止：
报名截止前
↓
活动开始前
scenes.left_note:
报名截止早于活动开始；
重新报名仍按原报名期。

rows.title: 更新取消规则与截止边界场景
rows.body: 活动开始时刻及以后，不允许取消。

rows.title: 保留重新报名的原有限制
rows.body: 原报名期内 + 仍有剩余名额。

rows.title: 新增场景：报名已截止，活动还没开始
rows.body: 本人可取消有效报名，但不能重新报名。

scenes.headline: Turn a vague request into rules you can check.
scenes.left:
Let users cancel
and return
their place.
scenes.left_note:
Ask first. Do not decide
the missing rules for me.

rows.title: Clarify the behavior
rows.body: Who can cancel? Until when? What if they repeat it?

rows.title: Define acceptance
rows.body: What changes on success, repeat, and failure?

rows.title: Review the change
rows.body: Which rules and scenarios follow a new deadline?

scenes.headline: Ask three questions that change implementation.
scenes.left:
Let users cancel
and return
their place.
scenes.left_note:
Keep missing decisions
open until confirmed.

rows.title: Who can cancel, and when?
rows.body: Ownership, registration status, and the deadline.

rows.title: How many places? Can they sign up again?
rows.body: When capacity returns; re-registration conditions.

rows.title: What about repeated or failed cancellation?
rows.body: What happens to the registration and capacity?

scenes.headline: Keep confirmed rules and open decisions separate.
scenes.left:
Before the deadline
Return 1 on success
No double return
No change on failure
scenes.left_note:
Full decisions and answers
are linked below the GIF.

rows.title: Who can act
rows.body: Only the owner of an active registration.

rows.title: When re-registration is allowed
rows.body: Within the registration period, with a place left.

rows.title: Open: the message for repeated cancellation
rows.body: No extra place is returned; the message is undecided.

scenes.headline: Make “return a place” an observable outcome.
scenes.left:
A starting state
A specific action
An expected result
scenes.left_note:
Expected results to verify,
not tests already passed.

rows.title: Success: remaining places 0 → 1
rows.body: Owner, active registration, before the deadline.

rows.title: Repeat: remaining places 1 → 1
rows.body: The same canceled registration releases no extra place.

rows.title: Failure: status and capacity stay unchanged
rows.body: Registration stays active. Show the confirmed error.

scenes.headline: A new cancel deadline must not extend sign-up.
scenes.left:
Cancel until:
registration closes
↓
the event starts
scenes.left_note:
Registration closes first.
Its deadline stays the same.

rows.title: Update cancellation and boundary scenarios
rows.body: No cancellation at or after the event's start time.

rows.title: Preserve the original re-registration rule
rows.body: Within the registration period, with a place left.

rows.title: New case: sign-up closed, event not started
rows.body: The owner can cancel, but cannot register again.
